en.text:
Casting your Class Ability grants <solar/>Cure x2.

Upon scoring multiple <solar/>Solar kills within 3 seconds of each, grants one stack of 'Burning Souls' for 10 seconds. Maximum of 3 stacks.

Progress is granted based on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />: 
Minor Enemies: 34% 
Elites, Players, and higher: 50%

Burning Souls grants the following benefits while active:
• 15% Increased <solar/>Solar Ability Damage
• Class Ability Healing is enhanced and granted to allies within 15 meters of cast.

Healing granted at 1|2|3 stacks of Burning Souls:
• <solar/>Cure x3
• <solar/>Cure x1 + <solar/>Restoration x1 for 3 seconds
• <solar/>Cure x2 + <solar/>Restoration x1 for 5 seconds

Restoration duration is increased by 50% with <solar/>Ember of Solace.
